clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post, the Warsong loggers wait on blades from Ratchet. Pixel, their courier, will trade the shipment for a weapon to protect herself on Ashenvale's dangerous roads. The blades are needed to keep the Horde's lumber camps working.

Pixel has brought heavy saw blades from Ratchet to Splintertree Post, but she will not hand them over for free. In Ashenvale's wilds, she values safety more than coin. She asks for a Deadly Blunderbuss in trade, so she can protect herself on her dangerous travels through hostile territory.

The Horde needs timber from Ashenvale to ease shortages across Durotar and the Barrens. Axes dull quickly against the ancient groves, so the Warsong loggers need goblin-forged blades. Pixel's shipment supplies the lumber camps, where the Horde cuts timber for outposts and war machines despite fierce resistance from the night elves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.
..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!
What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.
So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
